title: A Test With No Visible Prize
summary: On January 4th, 2012, someone posted a single black image to a 4chan board. White text, no explanation: "We are looking for highly intelligent individuals. To find them, we have devised a test." Buried inside the image was a hidden message pointing to another image. Then another. Then a phone number that read out a string of digits in a robotic recording. Then a QR code taped to a lamppost.
